description: Repeated incidents where a cache or session-store node's CPU saturates under normal-to-moderate load, causing downstream request failures, later traced to an undersized cache tier or a missing eviction policy.
Repeated incidents where a message or job queue backs up faster than consumers can drain it during traffic spikes, traced to a fixed consumer pool that doesn't scale with load.
Low-impact, one-off timing or performance variance in background/batch jobs with no user-facing effect — expected variation, not a recurring pattern.
